notes.content:
Hi! To promote Cursed Pantsu I am making a weeklong discount for Ecchi Jack and Ecchi Spirit.
It is the lowest price ever. If you are interested in the game, please consider buying it now.

notes.title: Cursed Pantsu demo available right now
notes.content:
Our new game Cursed Pantsu is participating in the Steam Next Fest. You can try the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733620/Cursed_Pantsu/]here[/url].

Kaori is a good girl who always does the right thing. But one day, succumbed to temptation, she had stolen panties in the Mall... 
Cursed Pantsu is a story-driven action-adventure game with RPG and platforming elements about Kaori’s adventures in the Hellish Mall.

notes.title: Week-long deal 50%!
notes.content: The Winter Sale is coming... But this week-long deal is for those who don't want to wait for it.

notes.title: Ecchi Jack is available now!
notes.content:
Finally, the game is released! That was a tough week. Here are some improvements compared to the beta-version:
- Jiggle physics for all girls.
- Steam achievements.
- New input scheme for H-scenes.
- Voice acting in H-scenes.
- The game's difficulty was lowered.
- A cheat-code to get additional chips.

We hope that you enjoy the game. And, of course, good luck!

notes.title: One week until the release
notes.content:
We have great news! The game will be available on August 19. Now, we are working hard to make it as polished as possible.
Another news is a change of the game's target audience from 17+ to 18+ players. 
Yeah, Ecchi Jack will be a hentai game. But don't worry, if you don't want adult content you can always enable the censor mode in game's settings.

notes.title: The release is delayed
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I would like to apologize for the delay. Right now the game is playable, but it is still too early to present it to players.

I'll announce the new release date soon.
